source.quote: FiiO's own parameters page, read 2026-11-24. « Hardware solution »: « SoC: GD32F303RE, DAC: FIIO-developed R2R DAC, USB decoding: SA9312L, AMP: SGM8262-2*2 ». « Max supported sampling rate » rows: « 384kHz-32bit/DSD256 (USB DAC) »; « 192kHz-24bit (Coaxial) »; « 96kHz-24bit (Optical) ». An « Oversampling setting » row reads « OS/NOS ». No Bluetooth row.

facts.chip: « FIIO-developed R2R DAC » - the maker's own ladder, no part number, with an SA9312L as USB receiver.

device_settings.why: « Oversampling setting: OS/NOS », same two-position switch as the K13 R2R. In NOS the device applies no oversampling of its own, which is the precondition `correctable` requires and the reason it is true here.
